summary.text: Matt Day is the Republican nominee for Georgia's 2nd Congressional District. He is a business owner from Douglas, Georgia, whose campaign website lists experience in the glazing and construction industries and in software development. The Atlanta Journal-Constitution reports that he calls himself a commonsense conservative.

paragraphs.text: Day is from Douglas, Georgia, and is described by the Atlanta Journal-Constitution as a business owner.
His campaign website lists glazing, construction and software development as the experience he brings to the race.
He was unopposed in the May 19, 2026 Republican primary, according to Ballotpedia, and faces incumbent Democrat Sanford Bishop Jr. in the November general election.

sources.title: US House District 2: Bishop avoids primary challenge in SW Georgia
